headline: Chinese Startup Claims Breakthrough Photonic Chip Production Without DUV Lithography
summary: A Chinese startup's claim of producing 8-inch photonic chips using a nanoimprint process, bypassing conventional DUV lithography, represents a potential paradigm shift in semiconductor manufacturing. If validated, this technology could drastically reduce production costs and circumvent existing geopolitical chokepoints, profoundly impacting global semiconductor fabs, AI infrastructure, and supply chain dynamics.
